answer: Vouching with decaying bonds: each new identity only earns after two established peers stake standing on it, and each voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N real reputations, and every caught fake leaves a quartz-hard trail of evidence the network replays. The lotus of honest standing compounds across epochs, while the mesa of vouching links spreads the cost of one bad actor across sponsors, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
